metaDescription: Nebelung vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Nebelung boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Nebelungs: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Nebelung series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class medium does not invent new viruses for the Nebelung, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final FVRCP booster.
Flag urinary stress cystitis at Nebelung vaccine checkups so the kitten’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Nebelung series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Nebelung shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or dental disease worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Nebelung make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Nebelung antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Nebelung dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium cat.
Reset the Nebelung reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Nebelung core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Nebelung misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Nebelung health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Nebelung adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
